info.title: RE-WILD API
info.description: Mycelium — offline-first sync backend for RE-WILD

post.description: Creates a new user account and returns a JWT access token
Authenticates with email and password and returns a JWT access token
Issues a new access token using the refresh token cookie
Revokes the refresh token and clears the auth cookie
Sends a password reset email if the address is registered. Always returns 200 to prevent account enumeration.
Resets the user's password using a valid time-limited token and signs them in
Validates a Google ID token, finds or creates the user, and returns a JWT access token

get.description: Returns the summary of the project promoted to Story Mode. No auth

put.description: Promotes a project saved on the server to Story Mode, or clears the promotion with a null projectId. Super admin only.

get.description: Returns the project, its levels and their files. Auth is optional. Allowed for the public game, the owner, users it is shared with and super admins. Everyone else gets 404. A flagged project gets 403 for everyone but the owner and super admins
Returns the live projects the caller owns, or that are shared with the caller, newest first

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: mine or shared. Defaults to mine

put.description: Upserts a project by ID. Path ID takes precedence over any ID in the request body.

delete.description: Deletes a project and its levels, and removes their files. The project stays as a tombstone so the owner's other devices drop it on their next sync. The public game cannot be deleted

get.description: Returns all levels for the authenticated user

put.description: Upserts a level by ID. Path ID takes precedence over any ID in the request body.

post.description: Bidirectional sync: push dirty local records and pull server-side changes since lastSyncedAt

get.description: Returns the confirmed files of the caller's live projects and levels

post.description: Owner only. Checks the file against its asset type's rule (scope, filename, content type and size) and returns a presigned PUT URL. The upload must send the requested Content-Type
Checks the uploaded object against its asset type's rule and makes it the file's new version. Purges uploads never confirmed within 1 hour

get.description: Returns one page of every live project of every user. Super admin only.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: name, author, updated or flagged. Defaults to updated

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: asc or desc. Defaults to desc

get.description: Returns every user account. Super admin only.
Returns a user account by ID. Super admin only.

put.description: Updates a user's editable fields. Super admin only.

post.description: Emails the user a password reset link. Super admin only.
Blocks a project: only its owner and super admins can play it. The public game cannot be flagged. Super admin only.

delete.description: Lifts the block on a project. Super admin only.

get.description: Owner only. Returns the users the project is shared with, newest first

post.description: Owner only. Gives a user play access to the project. Adding an existing share returns it. A flagged project cannot be shared

delete.description: Owner only. Removes a user's play access. It takes effect on their next start

get.description: Matches a display name by prefix (2 characters minimum) or an email exactly. Returns at most 10 users, never the caller and never an email

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Display name prefix or exact email
